AnalystNoteCreate.title: AnalystNoteCreate
AnalystNoteCreate.description:
Request body for per-entity POST …/notes endpoints.

Clients send only ``note_type`` and ``note_text``.  The route handler
injects ``entity_type`` and ``entity_id`` from the URL path before writing
to ``analyst_notes``.

CompanyListItem.title: CompanyListItem
CompanyListItem.description:
Row shape returned by ``GET /companies``. Includes the latest overall
risk score (if any) so the list can render a band badge per row.

HsMappingRead.title: HsMappingRead
HsMappingRead.description:
Serializes ``HsCodeMaterialMapping`` rows.

Column names are aliased to match the spec's preferred API names so the
frontend types stay stable even if internal column names drift.
